name: Candle shadows v1
summary: This EA trades based on candlestick shadow (wick) patterns, identifying setups where extended upper or lower shadows signal potential reversals. It enters buy positions when a candle shows a long lower shadow (hammer-like) and sell positions when a candle shows a long upper shadow (shooting star-like). The strategy uses configurable shadow-to-body ratios to qualify signals and applies stop loss/take profit for trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于K线影线（烛须）形态进行交易，通过识别延长的上影线或下影线来捕捉潜在的反转信号。当K线出现较长下影线（锤子线形态）时入场做多，出现较长上影线（射击之星形态）时入场做空。策略使用可配置的影线与实体比例来筛选信号，并设置止损止盈进行交易管理。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于K线影线形态判断市场反转点，利用长下影线作为看涨信号、长上影线作为看跌信号。入场条件为：当前K线的影线长度与实体长度的比值超过设定阈值，且影线长度也需达到最小绝对值要求，这确保了只选择影线显著突出的K线。出场条件依赖于预设的止损和止盈水平，止损通常设置在影线极值的另一侧，止盈则基于风险回报比进行计算。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额百分比的方式，用户可通过参数调整。资金管理方面，该EA依赖影线反转的经典技术分析逻辑，但在趋势行情中可能出现连续假信号导致多次亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制是其主要缺陷。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is identifying market reversal points using candlestick shadow patterns, where long lower shadows serve as bullish signals and long upper shadows as bearish signals. Entry conditions require that the shadow-to-body ratio of the current candle exceeds a configurable threshold, and the absolute shadow length must also meet a minimum value, ensuring only candles with significantly protruding shadows qualify. Exit conditions rely on pre-set stop loss and take profit levels, where the stop loss is typically placed beyond the shadow extreme and take profit is calculated based on a risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or a percentage-of-balance approach configurable by the user. Money management depends on the classic technical analysis logic of shadow reversals, but in trending markets consecutive false signals can lead to multiple losses, and the lack of a trend filter is a notable shortcoming.

parameters.name: ShadowRatio
parameters.description: 影线与实体的最小比例阈值

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单

pros: 基于经典的K线影线反转形态，逻辑清晰易懂，适合初学者理解和调试
影线比例与最小影线点数双重过滤机制，有效减少低质量信号的触发
止损止盈设置明确，风险控制框架基本完善，每笔交易的风险可量化
pros_en: Based on classic candlestick shadow reversal patterns with clear, understandable logic suitable for beginners to comprehend and debug
Dual filtering mechanism using both shadow ratio and minimum shadow pip requirements effectively reduces low-quality signal triggers
Well-defined stop loss and take profit settings provide a basic risk control framework with quantifiable risk per trade
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤机制，在强趋势行情中影线反转信号容易频繁失效导致连续亏损
没有考虑市场波动性（如ATR）来动态调整止损止盈，固定点数可能在高低波动环境下不适配
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓，增加不必要的风险敞口
cons_en: Lacks a trend filter mechanism, causing shadow reversal signals to frequently fail in strong trending markets, leading to consecutive losses
Does not account for market volatility (e.g., ATR) to dynamically adjust stop loss and take profit, making fixed pip values potentially unsuitable across varying volatility environments
Missing a new bar check mechanism, which may result in repeated entries on the same candle and unnecessary risk exposure
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX阈值），仅在逆趋势方向出现影线信号时才入场，避免在趋势延续中盲目做反转
引入ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据当前市场波动性自动调整止损距离，提高策略在不同市场条件下的适应性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX threshold) to only enter on shadow signals against the prevailing trend, avoiding blind reversals during trend continuations

Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanism that automatically adjusts distances based on current market volatility, improving strategy adaptability across different market conditions

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一K线上多次开仓造成过度暴露
影线反转策略在趋势行情中容易产生连续假信号，缺乏趋势过滤保护
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same candle, resulting in excessive exposure
Shadow reversal strategy is prone to consecutive false signals in trending markets without trend filter protection
